column1: # Seed two single-column ranges with three differing cells; assert the
# output range lists each diff with its left/right values and diff_kind.
# Wider screen so the diff_kind column's label can spill into the
# Right range A:C1..A:C3 = 11, 20, 33  (C4 left empty → only-left at row 4)
# RIGHT point: pointer returns to LEFT.start with no anchor; user
# navigates to C1, anchors, extends to C4 (the regression pattern).
# Three diff rows expected, in row-major order of the left range:
#   E1 = A:A1, F1 = 10,  G1 = 11,    H1 = both-different
#   E2 = A:A3, F2 = 30,  G2 = 33,    H2 = both-different
#   E3 = A:A4, F3 = 40,  G3 = (empty), H3 = only-left
# diff_kind labels are wider than the default 9-char column and spill
# into the empty column to the right; ASSERT_SCREEN proves the whole
# label landed on the rendered buffer.
